additional_info.subject: RE: ID0449451-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117135] emergencystop button is pressed CRM:02678000387
additional_info.body:
Hello Furkan,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0449451.
Last Friday 12.09.2025 I supported you for your onsite visit to troubleshoot the charger.
The charger had the error flags for QA26 and SF2 on, stating "emergency stop button pressed", while the emergency stop button was released.
We checked the 24V emergency trip line and it was okay, then we focused on the QA26:
The input IN1 to QA26 was not present, as well as the signal on 24V3.6.
The attention moved to the FC15 and XD3, and it was noticed that the FC15 had no 24 output, therefore the 24V3 signal was off:
The issue was solved by retriggering the EcoGs via FC15, and the emergency stop button error flag disappeared.
As there is no correlation between EcoGs and emergency stop button, I suspect the issue was really the FC15 not providing any output. While we measured some signals on XD3 having 24V, I believe this could be a wrong setting of the red bridges on XD3, or some of the connectors are actually short-circuited to the next ones.
As the issue was identified, being FC15 now providing 24V to the safety relais, I will forward you the ticket so to attach the work order.
With kind regards,
